name: rx-bench-router-rx-routes
description: The router-rx-routes task's own install: TanStack Router's generator and Vite plugin built from a fork (vendor/README.md: github.com/yumemi-thomas/router, branch rx-route-files, 8688de6), which adds the option `routeComponentExtensions` — a route file that is a component in another language, imported through a query.
